title: Removing Spurious Features can Hurt Accuracy and Affect Groups Disproportionately
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical and theoretical properties of spurious features in machine learning models. While it uses datasets containing identity terms (including religious ones like 'muslim' or 'christian') to evaluate group accuracy, its primary focus is on mathematical proofs and empirical validation of inductive bias, rather than a spiritual, theological, or ethical evaluation.
